title: TSM Aerospace Maintenance Readiness: Governed Fleet Intelligence
_note: Scripted scenario: engine outputs are canned via tests/e2e/helpers/stub-war-room.js, not live model output. Captions are DRAFTS. Narration lines are DRAFTS too: spoken text for --narrate, numbers written as words.

states.caption: Aerospace Maintenance Readiness war room
states.narration: This is the Aerospace Maintenance Readiness war room. A maintenance event lands here first, in one place. What follows is a simulated incident.

states.caption: AOG maintenance event report loaded
states.narration: An aircraft is on the ground at the hub. The operator loads the event report: a recurring bleed-air valve fault on three narrowbody aircraft.

states.caption: Six engines complete: risk scored 82/100
states.narration: Six engines read the same report. One aircraft is grounded, and two more fall below serviceable status within five days. Exposure runs from four hundred twenty thousand to six hundred ten thousand dollars. The risk score is eighty-two out of one hundred.

states.caption: Operations Strategist receives the aerospace relay
states.narration: One click escalates the case. The Operations Strategist receives the full analysis with nothing re-typed, and shows what the exposure becomes if the team acts now, or waits.

states.caption: Executive Portal with the aerospace relay
states.narration: The Executive Portal shows the same case, with the source of every number. One decision is waiting: authorize an exchange valve from a lessor within two hours, at a cost of thirty-eight thousand dollars. The system recommends. A person decides.
